the percentage of patients whose blood pressure is controlled varies by race and sex and that the level of medical care, as measured by the aggressiveness of drug therapy, is related to the level of blood pressure control.
the process of medical management is related to the level of blood pressure control and that the relationship between the two is stronger for black than for white hypertensive patients.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the process of medical decision-making and its relationship to the outcome of care, as reflected in blood pressure control.
the process of medical practice as a determinant of the level and impact of care.
the relationship of the medical care process to the outcome of blood pressure control.

the level of medical care is related to blood pressure control and that there is a relationship between level of medical care and race.
the medical care process is a major determinant in blood pressure control, and that the process varies by race and sex, with blacks receiving less aggressive medical care than whites.

the level of medical care, as measured by the aggressiveness of drug treatment, was a major determinant of blood pressure control.
the process of medical practice and the level of medical care are related to the outcome of blood pressure control.
